items.name: SR-71 BLACKBIRD
items.epitaph: It crossed continents at Mach 3. Its final destination was the museum.
items.why: High operating costs and shrinking defence budgets ended its frontline role; NASA research flying continued until 1999.
items.afterlife: Preserved aircraft and flight records keep its extraordinary speed and engineering on display.
items.note: 1964 is first flight; 1999 is the final NASA flight. USAF initially retired it in 1990, briefly reactivated it, and retired it again in 1998.
